description: This file defines a Java interface 'Event' with generic type parameter T, specifying methods to retrieve event name, data class type, and an ID extractor function for event data objects.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A Java interface representing a generic event with methods to obtain event metadata and data.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the name of the event as a String.

methods.name: getDataClass
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the type T of event data.

methods.name: getIdExtractor
methods.description: Returns a Function that extracts a Long ID from an object of type T.
